objects.name: Analytic 2099
objects.description: Real-time monitoring identifies an ICS Windows asset bypassing designated DNS resolvers, generating tunneling-like DNS content, or establishing HTTPS/TLS sessions to unapproved DoH resolver/API infrastructure from a process not authorized for encrypted DNS. Require a resolver-policy or asset-role violation plus suspicious query/content/process/destination evidence; suppress approved browsers, security products, vendor cloud services, and documented maintenance.

x_mitre_log_source_references.name: NSM:DNS
